changes.before: We therefore examined biochemical redox indices and Nox1/Nox4 mRNA in medullary blocks containing the RVLM and adjacent tissue. The comparison between model and sham rats used the same day-28 endpoint; a restoration cohort was examined at a later endpoint after implant removal. A related report described Ang II/AT1-R expression in this model [13]. Blood-pressure observations were shared with that report, whereas the biochemical and transcript analyses presented here were not reported there. Archived blood-pressure records are provided in the supplement. Illustrative H&E fields are included among the main figures, with source material retained in the supplement. The present study characterizes regional group differences and examines their relevance to a possible redox phenotype.
changes.after: We therefore examined biochemical redox indices and Nox1/Nox4 mRNA in medullary blocks containing the RVLM and adjacent tissue. The comparison between model and sham rats used the same day-28 endpoint; a restoration cohort was examined at a later endpoint after implant removal. A related report described Ang II/AT1-R expression in this model [13]. Blood-pressure observations were shared with that report, whereas the biochemical and transcript analyses presented here were not reported there. Archived blood-pressure records are provided in the supplement. Illustrative H&E fields and source material are provided in the supplement. The present study characterizes regional group differences and examines their relevance to a possible redox phenotype.

changes.before: The parent experiment numbered 60 rats and allocated them by random numbers to sham operation (10) or model induction (50). All sham rats survived. During model induction, 6 rats died during surgery and 3 afterward; 41 survived, including 7 with implant loss and 34 with retained implants. After imaging and blood-pressure screening on day 28, successfully modeled rats were assigned by random numbers to model, restoration, and superior cervical ganglion resection groups of 10. The disposition of the remaining 4 rats with retained implants was undocumented. This report includes only sham, model, and restoration rats, initially 10 per group; ganglion-resection and electrophysiological results are not presented.
changes.after: The parent experiment numbered 60 rats and allocated them by random numbers to sham operation (10) or model induction (50). All sham rats survived. During model induction, 6 rats died during surgery and 3 afterward; 41 survived, including 7 with implant loss and 34 with retained implants. After imaging and blood-pressure screening on day 28, successfully modeled rats were assigned by random numbers to model, restoration, and superior cervical ganglion resection groups of 10. The remaining 4 rats with retained implants were kept in reserve and were not allocated to the three subsequent 10-rat groups. This report includes only sham, model, and restoration rats, initially 10 per group; ganglion-resection and electrophysiological results are not presented.

changes.before: The previously reported Ang II/AT1-R expression changes in this model provide another point of connection [13]. Experimental work on RVLM angiotensin signaling and angiotensin-associated NOX pathways offers a possible framework for interpreting the regional findings [18,19]. Angiotensin signaling and sympathetic discharge were not measured in the present analyses. Accordingly, the relationships illustrated in Fig. 4 are proposed links for testing, rather than an established sequence connecting cervical perturbation, NOX activity and blood-pressure regulation.
changes.after: The previously reported Ang II/AT1-R expression changes in this model provide another point of connection [13]. Experimental work on RVLM angiotensin signaling and angiotensin-associated NOX pathways offers a possible framework for interpreting the regional findings [18,19]. Angiotensin signaling and sympathetic discharge were not measured in the present analyses. Accordingly, connections between cervical perturbation, NOX activity and blood-pressure regulation remain hypotheses requiring direct testing.

changes.after: 因此，本研究检测含RVLM及邻近组织的延髓块中的氧化还原生化指标和Nox1/Nox4 mRNA。模型组与伪手术组在同一第28天终点比较，复位队列则在异物取出后的较晚终点观察。相关论文曾报告本模型的Ang II/AT1-R表达[13]。两文共享来源实验中的血压观察，本稿生化及转录本分析则未在该文报告。存档血压记录、HE示例视野及来源资料见补充材料。本研究描述区域指标的组间差异，考察可能伴随该模型出现的氧化还原表型。

changes.before: 既往报道的本模型Ang II/AT1-R表达变化提供了另一项联系[13]。有关RVLM血管紧张素信号及血管紧张素相关NOX通路的实验研究，为理解本研究的区域观察提供了可能的框架[18,19]。本次分析未测量血管紧张素信号活性或交感神经放电。因此，图4所示关系是有待检验的拟议联系，而非已经确立的连接颈部扰动、NOX活性与血压调节的作用顺序。
changes.after: 既往报道的本模型Ang II/AT1-R表达变化提供了另一项联系[13]。有关RVLM血管紧张素信号及血管紧张素相关NOX通路的实验研究，为理解本研究的区域观察提供了可能的框架[18,19]。本次分析未测量血管紧张素信号活性或交感神经放电。因此，颈部扰动、NOX活性与血压调节之间的联系仍是假说，需要直接检验。
